pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal patches with predominantly smooth-to-slightly-rounded edge gradients; colors range from medium brown to tan with moderate spatial area on the ventral neck and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, relatively wide light-tan pathways forming a dense topological network with frequent tri-axial and quad-axial junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark-colored mane is visible along the dorsal neck line, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least five small, dark-plumaged birds (Buphagus sp.) clinging to the pelage across the lateral neck and chest regions.
